description: A new customer lands at $1.2M ARR with a small initial deployment (1 rack). The platform tracks adoption velocity, identifies expansion triggers, and helps CSM time expansion conversations. Three expansion waves drive ARR to $4.8M by end of year (4x land) -- showing CRO how the platform identifies and accelerates expansion pipeline.

phases.name: Initial Deployment
phases.description: New customer lands with a single rack (32 GPUs) at $1.2M ARR. Hardware arrives and is commissioned. Solutions Architect runs first workload onboarding. CSM establishes cadence and baseline KPIs. Health starts at-risk (new, unproven) and climbs toward healthy as deployment completes successfully.

plot_points.description: Hardware delivery and rack installation begins. Single rack with 32 GPUs, networking gear, and cooling infrastructure arrives at customer data center. Field engineer on-site for commissioning.

csm_action.description: Coordinate field engineer on-site. Validate rack placement, power, and cooling prerequisites.

plot_points.description: Rack commissioned and network configured. Configuration accuracy at 96%. Solutions Architect begins workload onboarding with VP AI/ML's team -- first training job submitted.

csm_action.description: Solutions Architect leads workload onboarding workshop. Configure GPU scheduling and monitoring dashboards.

plot_points.description: First AI training workload completes successfully in 18 hours (benchmark target: 24h). Time-to-First-Workload achieved in 12 days (target: 14). VP AI/ML impressed -- shares results with Infrastructure Director.

csm_action.description: Capture first-workload success metrics. Create internal case study for champion to share. $12K CAC payback begins.

plot_points.description: 30-day success review with VP AI/ML and Infrastructure Director. GPU utilization at 35% with 1 workload type. CSM presents adoption roadmap showing path to full utilization. VP AI/ML agrees to onboard second ML team.

csm_action.description: Present 30-day adoption scorecard. Map workload expansion roadmap. Identify second ML team for onboarding.

phases.name: Workload Ramp
phases.description: VP AI/ML onboards two additional ML teams. GPU utilization climbs rapidly from 35% to 72%. Workload diversity grows from 1 to 3 types (training, fine-tuning, batch inference). Platform proves its value as adoption velocity exceeds projections. CSM begins planting expansion seeds.

plot_points.description: Second ML team onboarded. GPU utilization jumps to 48%. Workload Diversity Score increases to 2 (training + fine-tuning). Training job completion rate holds at 92%.

csm_action.description: Track workload ramp metrics. Share adoption velocity report with VP AI/ML showing above-benchmark performance.

plot_points.description: GPU utilization crosses 60%. Third ML team begins batch inference workloads. Workload Diversity Score hits 3. Compute hour consumption trending +18% MoM. CSM flags early expansion signal in CRM.

csm_action.description: Flag expansion signal: utilization at 60% with steep trajectory. Prepare capacity forecast showing 80% threshold in 4 weeks.

plot_points.description: GPU utilization hits 72%. Capacity utilization at 75%. Workload Growth Velocity at +22% MoM. Expansion Probability (90d) climbs to 45%. CSM schedules capacity planning conversation with VP AI/ML.

csm_action.description: Present capacity trajectory to VP AI/ML: current runway depletes in 6 weeks at current growth. Recommend proactive expansion discussion.

plot_points.description: Capacity planning meeting with VP AI/ML and Infrastructure Director. GPU utilization at 78%, capacity at 80%. CSM presents ROI of first 10 weeks: $12K CAC fully recovered, workload adoption 40% above plan. VP AI/ML proposes POC for expanded workloads on additional capacity.

csm_action.description: Build expansion business case for VP AI/ML. TCO comparison showing on-prem vs. cloud cost advantage at scale. Prepare CFO-ready ROI deck.

phases.name: First Expansion
phases.description: First expansion wave: 1 rack to 2 racks (+$600K ARR, total $1.8M). VP AI/ML's POC results plus capacity data convince Infrastructure Director. CFO approves based on proven ROI. New capacity deployed in 3 weeks. GPU utilization normalizes to 55% with doubled capacity, then climbs again as new workloads onboard.

plot_points.description: Infrastructure Director approves first expansion: 1 additional rack (32 GPUs), $600K incremental ARR. CFO signs off citing proven 8-week CAC payback and workload demand data from CSM.

csm_action.description: Provide deployment timeline, configuration spec, and reference customer data. Coordinate with sales for PO processing.

plot_points.description: Second rack commissioned and online in 18 days (faster than initial 25-day deployment). GPU utilization drops from 82% to 55% as capacity doubles. Training job queues clear. Performance metrics improve across the board.

csm_action.description: Field engineer oversight for second rack commissioning. Validate performance baselines and workload migration.

plot_points.description: VP AI/ML approves POC for inference workloads on new capacity. Workload Diversity Score grows to 4 (adding real-time inference). This decision plants the seed for the second expansion wave.

csm_action.description: Solutions Architect leads inference workload architecture review. Configure low-latency inference pipeline and monitoring.

plot_points.description: QBR with VP AI/ML, Infrastructure Director. Present expansion ROI: $600K investment generating $180K/quarter in workload value. GPU utilization back to 65% and climbing. Platform delivers clear visibility into adoption acceleration.

csm_action.description: QBR preparation and delivery. Update success plan with next-phase expansion targets. Share industry benchmark comparisons.

phases.name: Multi-Workload Adoption
phases.description: Inference workloads go live and GPU utilization climbs rapidly on the 2-rack footprint. Workload Diversity Score hits 5. Capacity utilization crosses 80% again -- second expansion trigger fires. Minor performance pressure creates urgency. CSM navigates a brief period of resource contention before second expansion closes: 2 racks to 4 racks (+$1.2M ARR, total $3.0M).

plot_points.description: Inference workloads go live in production. P95 inference latency at 42ms (target: 50ms). Workload Diversity Score reaches 5 types. GPU utilization climbs to 68%.

csm_action.description: Document inference workload success. Create benchmark comparison showing performance vs. cloud alternatives.

plot_points.description: GPU utilization crosses 80% threshold. Capacity utilization at 82%. Second expansion signal fires. Workload Growth Velocity at +15% MoM. Expansion Probability (90d) jumps to 65%. Minor training job queue delays begin.

csm_action.description: Flag second expansion trigger: utilization at 82%, trajectory steep. Prepare capacity forecast and expansion sizing for 2 additional racks.

plot_points.description: CSM-led expansion planning session. Present data: 82% utilization, 15% MoM growth, runway depletes in 8 weeks. VP AI/ML champions the case internally. Infrastructure Director requests pricing for 2 additional racks.

csm_action.description: Build second expansion business case. Demonstrate compounding ROI: first expansion paid back in 10 weeks. Prepare CFO presentation.

plot_points.description: CFO approves second expansion: 2 additional racks (64 GPUs), $1.2M incremental ARR. Total footprint grows to 4 racks (128 GPUs), $3.0M ARR. CFO cites compounding ROI data from CSM reports.

csm_action.description: Coordinate deployment plan for 2-rack expansion. Stagger commissioning to minimize disruption to running workloads.

plot_points.description: Second expansion racks commissioned. Total footprint: 4 racks, 128 GPUs. GPU utilization normalizes to 52%. All workload queues clear. Health stabilizes at 84. Platform demonstrates clear L&E flywheel.

csm_action.description: Oversee staggered deployment of 2 expansion racks. Validate performance baselines. Document deployment efficiency improvements.

phases.name: Strategic Expansion
phases.description: VP AI/ML presents board-level AI strategy requiring 10-rack total footprint. GPU utilization on 4 racks climbs to 75%. Third expansion wave: 4 racks to 10 racks (+$1.8M ARR, total $4.8M). This is a strategic deal -- not capacity-driven but roadmap-driven. CSM facilitates multi-stakeholder alignment across VP AI/ML, Infrastructure Director, and CFO. NRR hits 400%.

plot_points.description: VP AI/ML shares 18-month AI roadmap requiring 10-rack total footprint. Plans include production inference at scale, multi-model training, and edge deployment preparation. CSM positions this as a strategic partnership discussion.

csm_action.description: Co-develop infrastructure roadmap with VP AI/ML. Map workload requirements to hardware specifications. Build 18-month capacity model.

plot_points.description: GPU utilization climbs to 75% on 4-rack footprint. Workload Growth Velocity at +12% MoM. Expansion Probability (90d) at 78%. Platform data validates VP AI/ML's capacity projections -- CFO requests formal expansion proposal.

csm_action.description: Assemble strategic expansion proposal: 6 additional racks, phased deployment, volume pricing. Include 12-month ROI projection based on proven adoption curves.

plot_points.description: CFO approves strategic expansion: 6 additional racks (192 GPUs), $1.8M incremental ARR with volume discount. Total footprint: 10 racks (320 GPUs), $4.8M ARR. 4x the initial land. Deal structured as multi-year strategic partnership.

csm_action.description: Coordinate multi-phase deployment plan for 6 racks. Establish strategic partnership governance framework. Set up executive sponsor cadence with CFO.

plot_points.description: First 3 strategic expansion racks commissioned. GPU utilization normalizes to 48% across expanded footprint. New workload types onboarding: reinforcement learning and model serving. Partner NPS at 72.

csm_action.description: Oversee phased commissioning of strategic expansion. Validate infrastructure at scale. Begin long-term capacity monitoring.

plot_points.description: All 10 racks operational. Health score at 88. NRR: 400% (1.2M to 4.8M in 48 weeks). VP AI/ML presents partnership success to board. CSM documents complete Land & Expand playbook for replication across portfolio.

csm_action.description: Executive business review celebrating 4x land. Document L&E playbook. Set up next-year strategic planning cadence.

kpi_overrides.note: Time-to-First-Workload achieved in 12 days (under 14-day target). Improves with each subsequent expansion deployment.
Deployment Cycle Time improves dramatically: initial 25 days, first expansion 18 days, second expansion 14 days as team gains experience.
Hardware Commissioning Time drops with each wave -- learning curve effect.
Minor incident blip during multi-workload adoption (phase 3) when utilization spikes, quickly resolved.
System uptime stays above 99.5% throughout -- no major outages in this arc.
Thermal management stable -- each expansion adds cooling capacity proportionally.

GPU utilization is the primary story driver: 0% -> 35% -> 72% -> 82%(spike) -> 55%(post-expand) -> 80%(spike) -> 52%(post-expand) -> 75% -> 48%(post-expand). Sawtooth pattern as utilization climbs then resets with each expansion.
Workload Diversity grows steadily: 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6+ types as new teams and use cases onboard.
Training job completion rate stays above 88% except during brief capacity pressure in phase 3.
Inference latency improves as inference workloads mature and infrastructure scales.
Partner engagement strengthens with each expansion deal cycle.
Co-selling opportunities increase as expansion deals involve channel partner.
QBR frequency increases from quarterly to bimonthly as relationship deepens.
Capacity utilization follows sawtooth: climbs to 80%+ triggering expansion, resets to ~50% after each capacity add, then climbs again.
Capacity trajectory strongly positive through all phases -- steep positive slope drives expansion confidence.
Workload Growth Velocity sustained above 10% MoM throughout -- the engine of the L&E flywheel.
Expansion Probability climbs before each expansion decision, resets after close, then climbs again. Three peaks at ~60%, ~75%, ~85%.
